{07 00 00}Y'know, pretty much the
only things that wash up on
the beach are seashells...
{07 16 00}Every now and then, though,
you find something TOTALLY
weird, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 00 00}After I get a little wave
therapy from the sea...

{07 14 00}I pick up seashells and sell
them to {ff 00 00 06}Tom Nook{ff 00 00 00}!

{07 0a 00}It's like getting a double-
dip ice-cream cone from
nature, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{03 01 00 01}
